item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 26 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 26 #SLPRSD
Issued at 08:40 AM 05 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Cawayan, Aroroy, Baleno, Placer), #Romblon(Calatrava, SanAgustin, SanAndres, Corcuera, Banton, Magdiwang, SanFernando and Cajidiocan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Masbate(Mandaon, Milagros, Balud) and #Romblon(Romblon) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
